name: qdq_q_ref

job.purpose: ot_hgi_qdq_q B2 quarter cluster q8 (ref_tile): WIRES-ONLY parent over 11 hard children with their own clock trees: track-B decoder (dxl / dbq / daq, CLOSED views), 4 lane-pair response-FIFO tiles (qdq_lq_ref) and the four q8b face-anchored M5 leaves that hold what q7 kept as 14.3k cluster flops: qdq_fr (rec -> S3, S face), qdq_core (queue / hazards / read walk / wrq / retire, S band), qdq_asm (beat queue, pops, beat placement, lane-pair | decoder gap), qdq_wr (result FIFO SRAM, wwq, finish detection, N face). A flop at every seam pin; production bench 183 cycles vs 168 priced (1.089x), exact, mutants fail. Cluster clock = spine over 11 child clock pins, each its own leaf, balanced to pin arrival + child insertion; die-context IO reference = child pin arrival + child insertion (tools/ref_tile/wires_only_ioref.py).

benches.name: walk_rows3
benches.cmd: S=3 MUT=0 QDQ_G='-GSPANPIPE=1 -GPIN4=1' QDQ_PLUS=+ROWS=3 bash tools/hgi_unit_tput/run_qdq_case.sh results/rtl/tput_map_1011/ds_qdq_b2/lq_pair_vectors {RUN}/qdq_rows3

why_floorplan: q8 (q7 fc3cf212a: cluster clock spine diverged, 1,816 flop leaves padded individually to 1.79 ns): four face-anchored leaves. fr (172.8,25.92) under the rec pins; core above it, W face on the lq0|lq1 gap (wrq straight to the W pins, 173 um), N face under asm; asm (172.8,224.64) in the lane-pair | decoder gap: hq_p1 / hq_p2 on W facing lq1 / lq2, hq_p0 on S, hq_p3 on N, d_x on E 60.48 um from the dxl W face; wr (319.68,444.96) 25.92 um under the N pins, y enters its S face above the dxl|dbq channel. Decoders 86.4 um lower than q7 (dxl / dbq y 259.2, daq y 86.4; relative positions unchanged): the N band needs 2.16 + 20 (pin-face rule) + 125.28 (wr: SRAM 77.76 + 2 x 22.16 + lattice) + a 64.8 um channel for xs (1,024 b dxl N -> dbq N) = 212 um; at 43.2 um lower the channel would be 21.6 um (cut 1.05). child_lattice 2.16 so wr sits at y 444.96 (M4 / M5 pins and rows on track; the M6 children stay on their 43.2 um origins). Cut analysis: results in the stream log 10-13 (every cut <= 0.54, longest hop y 515 b ~450 um).
structural_change: q8: the cluster's own logic (14.3k flops on one cluster spine that diverged to 1.79 ns insertion in q7; q6 congestion, q5 floorplan) is hardened as four face-anchored M5 leaves with their own clock trees (fr / core / asm / wr); the parent is wires only, its clock is a spine over 11 child clock pins; decoders moved down 86.4 um, result SRAM moved into the N-face write leaf.

cut_analysis.rule: demand / (tracks at 50 % reserve) <= 0.55-0.60; tracks = face length / pitch on M2,M4,M6 (0.036/0.048/0.064, horizontal) or M3,M5,M7 (vertical)

cuts.seam: lq0 -> asm S (hq_p0 512 b + pops) up the lq | fr-core channel x 140.4-172.8
lq3 -> asm N (hq_p3 512 b) down the same channel, y 354-458
lq1 / lq2 -> asm W (hq_p1 / hq_p2, facing)
asm E -> dxl W (d_x 1,024 + d_v + d_hd 18), 60.5 um gap
dxl N -> dbq N (xs 1,024) in the 64.8 um channel under wr
daq S -> wr S (y 512 + vo + faults) round daq E and up the dxl | dbq channel (51.8 um)
wr N -> cluster N pins (wwq 2,240 + cr / done / grant), 25.9 um
core W -> cluster W pins (wrq 128 + cr + grant) in the lq0 | lq1 channel (23.76 um)
core N -> asm S (bp 41 + pops / fire / status)
asm N -> wr W (m 19 + valid, i_wf back) and core <-> wr (finish pulse, act, status)

cut_analysis.note: every hop is flop at the pin -> wire -> flop at the pin; all <= 300 um except the decode result y (daq's S-face pins are on the closed tile's far side from wr: ~470 um, TT 0.76 ps/um = 357 ps of the 683 ps hop budget) and the 5-bit core <-> wr status hop (~400 um).
